newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali down 6.18 pct on CA jitters.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali down 6.18 pct on CA jitters.

text.p: Shares in EA-Generali slumped 6.18 percent in Vienna on Thursday, extending Wednesday's 3.95 percent fall, as investors sensed the firm's chances of buying into Creditanstalt-Bankverein were fading.
AT 0914 the insurer was 210.0 schillings down at 3,190.00 on volume of 2,606 lots.
"EA-Generali is under pressure because of the whole Creditanstalt business," a trader said.
"Firstly, it looks as though they may not be successful in their bid and secondly, there is concern that they may lose out on the business they have through Creditanstalt."
EA-Generali heads an Austrian-German-Italian consortium that has bid a reported 720-730 schillings a share for two thirds of the government's 70 percent of Creditanstalt ordinary shares.
It also operates insurance unit CA-Generali Versicherung with Creditanstalt.

But an 11th hour bid for Creditanstalt from the nation's biggest bank Bank Austria looked likely to pip the EA-Generali group at the post and raised fears the firm may lose lucrative insurance business. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
